summary:
Miha'Veyr is an upcoming turn-based strategy game built by two enthusiastic ex-competitive players.

The game as of now is nowhere near finished. Heavily inspired by Kintara, doesn't fall even close to the same category though.

Build history dates back a few weeks only, but theorycrafting has gone for over 10 years in a combined effort. Mind you, we've been gaming together for 25+ years.

Rough game ETA will be 1-6 months, with playable Alpha TBD. Estimated time can vary.

If we decide to go with Alpha route, more tokens -> more chance of joining in. Also booster packs can only be purchased with tokens.

This is a gaming startup, so treat it as such. Fees will be used to actually build the game and will be split even 50/50. At some point we will hire more people to work for us, bonus points if you see the vision and enjoy the gameplay.

1v1, 2v2, arena, shinies, turn-based strategy. No wallet connection, onchain collectibles (ccg, tcg). Fully OC, no game like this exists. That's where our potential lies.

Supply bought at launch will not be locked as we've yet to decide what to do with it. Supply amount will be trimmed from initial launch to eliminate snipers to around ~ 33.3% for foundation.

No discord/tg. In the future, discord will be put up but for now it's private between us two.
